# CANDIDATE: VWAP_CONTINUATION_BEARISH_PUT_OOS

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The VWAP_CONTINUATION trigger captures intraday directional bias when the first three RTH closes are on one side of VWAP and the first morning bar continues the trend. For bearish PUT setups, this edge is expected to persist OOS with Sharpe >=0.70, providing additional entries on J's winner days without increasing loser-day losses.

## Mechanism

Enter on the first bar ≤10:30 ET that continues the trend established by the first three RTH closes all being above/below VWAP. For PUTs, we require the first three closes below VWAP and the bar to be a bearish continuation (breakdown or pullback). Entry at next bar open, ITM-2 strike, 0DTE, with chart-stop primary (SPY closes above the VWAP continuation level + $0.50 buffer), premium stop -50% (catastrophe cap), TP1 at +50% (sell 2/3), runner trails via chandelier profit-lock. Exit by 15:50 ET.
